_: Nøstet in English: Woolly (a path puzzle). The line is a thread of yarn; «Dagens nøste» (today's ball of yarn) is «Today's yarn».
Fill every square before you take {t}.
Tråden er ved det siste tallet. Gå tilba: The thread is at the last number. Go back to fill the rest.
Tråden går bare til ruta rett ved siden: The thread only goes to the square right next to it, above or below.
Tråden er nøstet opp igjen. Angre henter: The thread is wound back up. Undo brings it back.
Du har brukt alle hintene: You have used all your hints
Tråden tok feil vei. Den er ført tilbake: The thread took a wrong turn. It has been led back and on to {t}.
The thread has been led on to {t}.
Bruk piltastene for å trekke tråden fra: Use the arrow keys to draw the thread from 1.
Trekk én sammenhengende tråd gjennom all: Draw one unbroken thread through every square. Start on 1, pass the numbers in order and finish on the highest.
Dra fingeren fra 1 til ruta ved siden av: Drag your finger from 1 to the square next to it, and on. You can also tap a square in the same row or column as the end of the thread.
Dra tilbake langs tråden, eller trykk på: Drag back along the thread, or tap a square on the thread to cut it there.
Tråden går sidelengs eller opp og ned, a: The thread goes sideways or up and down – never diagonally, never through a wall and never across itself.
Se etter hjørner og trange ganger: der e: Look for corners and narrow passages: there is often only one way in and one way out.
Tallene sier rekkefølgen, ikke avstanden: The numbers give the order, not the distance. There can be many squares between 2 and 3.
Det siste tallet tar du til slutt, når a: You take the last number at the very end, once every other square is on the thread.
Står du fast? Hint fører tråden riktig f: Stuck? A hint leads the thread on to the next number. Every board has only one solution.
Dagens nøste er det samme for alle: lite: Today's yarn is the same for everyone: small on Monday, bigger at the weekend.
Med tastatur: piltastene trekker tråden,: With a keyboard: the arrow keys draw the thread, Backspace takes it back one step, H gives a hint and P pauses.
And the numbers in the right order.
Hvert brett er nytt og har bare én løsni: Every board is new and has only one solution – you never need to guess.
Brettet, {n} ganger {n} ruter. Piltasten: The board, {n} by {n} squares. The arrow keys draw the thread.
The board is waiting for you.
Du løste dagens nøste på {tid} første ga: You solved today's yarn in {tid} the first time.
Alle i hele landet får det samme nøstet: Everyone in the country gets the same yarn today.
Uten hint! Alle i hele landet får det sa: No hints! Everyone in the country gets the same yarn today.
Første brett på {str} – nå har du en rek: First board on {str} – now you have a record to beat!
